title: Daughter will love it.
text: I have seen other reviews detailing how unimpressed they are with the package. I have not opened the box, which arrived undamaged, but have seen the pictures of the content. My daughter is a die-hard Star Wars fan and will absolutely love all of it. Could it have more? Sure. However, the advertising says 3 to 6.  What more do you want?
label: positive
